abstract: This study examines how generative artificial intelligence and prompt quality affect creativity among advertising professionals. Ninety-eight participants were randomly assigned to three conditions: no GenAI, GenAI use, or GenAI use after prompt training. Participants who used GenAI after training generated significantly more ideas than those in the other conditions, although perceived creativity did not differ. Content analysis of prompts revealed key nuances in human–GenAI collaboration. Results underscore the importance of intentionally integrating GenAI to support divergent thinking in creative work.

ur.ai_reason: 人类与GenAI创意协作,广告从业者研究
ur.tldr: 研究广告创意专业人士如何与生成式AI（GenAI）在创意构思阶段进行协作，探讨人机协同创作在广告领域的实践模式、效能感知与面临的挑战，为GenAI在专业创意工作流程中的整合提供经验参考。

title: Human-GenAI Collaboration in Creative Ideation: A Study with Advertising Professionals
title_zh: 人与生成式AI在创意构思中的协作：面向广告从业者的研究
